## Delivered / mappings

- supabase/migrations/20261024001200_deliverable_commands.sql: fixed deliverable workflow/criteria revision/final evidence fields, append-only deliverable_revisions and trusted-only deliverable_gate_assessments. Both new tables force RLS before grants; only authorized detail readers can read revisions; no client gate writes. Current catalog **28tables/341columns/31public functions**.
- create_deliverable requires active same-term owner, nonarchived same-term lead, phase/outcome/criteria, one finite date or timestamp, visibility/title and current actor. Scoped committee.manage authorizes direct commitments and reassignment; ordinary members may propose only themselves. Proposed records require manager approval before work begins. Current configured unit manager authority also permits that lead's deliverable detail/edit reads, without changing other work kinds or unrelated unit/term access. No inference from MEAn/head labels.
- update_deliverable preserves original deadline, requires a reason, attributes immutable content/owner/deadline snapshots and increments criteria revision on criteria/outcome changes. Classification retains P07 immutable identity behavior. Generic create_work_item/update_work_item now reject deliverables, preventing incomplete metadata or revision bypass. Other work kinds retain their P07 commands.
- transition_deliverable implements proposed → draft → in_progress/submitted → accepted, reasoned return to draft and cancellation before acceptance. Only the current owner submits final evidence; a configured independent manager accepts with explicit current-criteria confirmation and verification notes. Server checks current version, owner activity, blocker, evidence and three current-version/current-authority gate assessments. Unknown, stale or governed mandatory gates fail closed. Accepted output cancellation/reopening remains closed pending later governed workflows.
- Gate assessments support only trusted not_applicable for finance/publicity/contributions. There is no client assessment/waiver/approval command. P29 must supply governed readiness; the clean acceptance regression uses trusted synthetic internal-output non-applicability fixtures, not invented finance/publicity approvals. Readiness on P08 views remains explicitly provisional even when a workflow state is accepted.
- src/features/deliverables/DeliverableEditor.tsx and commands.ts: real SDK create/update/transition/context adapter, protected list/detail integration, scoped owner choices, explicit self-proposal, edit/reassignment, lifecycle actions and current criteria confirmation. Inactive owners retain attribution and enter a derived manager-scoped reassignment queue. URL IDs remain stable. Conflict preserves draft text; uncertain transport/malformed receipts freeze inputs and retry the identical key/payload. No browser draft storage or optimistic fake success.
- Editor creates/changes date-only Manila targets. Existing timestamp deadlines remain intact in this form; the typed SQL command supports reasoned timestamp changes. Visibility is chosen at creation and retained. Final evidence is a bounded reference/note, not a claim that a file was verified. No P10 tasks/contributions or P29 provider approvals implemented.
- Scripts preview-p09.cjs/verify-p09.cjs and deliverable-authoring-db.cjs extend the isolated, clearly labeled P08 loopback harness with a fixed fictional scoped manager and an explicit RPC allowlist. No fixture endpoint or auth bypass enters production. Existing equivalent P08 named SQL file retained; P09 assertions are separated into supabase/tests/deliverable_commands.test.sql and test:deliverable-authoring for clear ownership.
